common.attachEmail: Attach my email address ({emailAddress} – <change>change</change>) so you can follow up

@common.attachEmail.description: Label for an opt-in checkbox to include the user's email address so the team can follow up on their report. Shared verbatim by the crash-report, error-report, and feedback dialogs. "You" is the Cmdr team; the user is the one speaking. This variant appears when the app already has an address on file, shown in the parentheses; when it doesn't, common.attachEmailPrompt takes its place, so keep the two wordings parallel. <change> wraps the inline link that opens Settings on the field holding that address; keep its text short and lowercase, a verb the user acts on.

placeholders.emailAddress: the user's email address on file (e.g. alex@example.com)

@common.attachEmail.screenshotNote: Pictured in the error-report dialog; the crash-report and feedback dialogs place the same checkbox above their Send button.

@common.attachEmailInputLabel.description: Accessible name of the email field that appears under the attach-email checkbox in the crash-report, error-report, and feedback dialogs once the user ticks it with no address on file. It has no visible label (the checkbox above it carries the wording), so this is what a screen reader announces. Keep it short.

common.attachEmailInvalid: That doesn''t look like an email address

@common.attachEmailInvalid.description: Inline validation message under the email field in the crash-report, error-report, and feedback dialogs, shown while what the user typed can't be an address (no @, or a space in it). The Send button stays disabled until it's fixed. Gentle and non-blaming, never accusing the user of a mistake; avoid the words "error" and "invalid".

@common.attachEmailPlaceholder.description: Placeholder inside the email field in the crash-report, error-report, and feedback dialogs, showing the expected shape. Localize the LOCAL part to your language's natural word for "you" (German "du@", French "vous@"), and keep the "example.com" domain: it's the domain reserved for examples (RFC 2606), so it can never be someone's real address. All three email placeholders (settings.updates.emailPlaceholder, common.attachEmailPlaceholder, onboarding.stepBeta.emailPlaceholder) must use the SAME address in your language.

common.attachEmailPrompt: Attach my email address so you can follow up

@common.attachEmailPrompt.description: Label for the same opt-in checkbox as common.attachEmail, used when the app has no address on file yet: ticking it reveals a field to type one in. Shared by the crash-report, error-report, and feedback dialogs. "You" is the Cmdr team; the user is the one speaking. Keep it parallel to common.attachEmail, minus the parenthesized address and its link.

common.downloadsFdaHint: Cmdr needs Full Disk Access to watch your Downloads folder. <settingsLink>Open System Settings</settingsLink>

@common.downloadsFdaHint.description: Hint shown when the downloads watcher lacks Full Disk Access. <settingsLink> wraps the inline action that opens System Settings.
